pages.text: $(italic)$(#6b5a45)Press V to open it, and press V again to close it.$()$(br2)$(bold)Opening it$()$(br2)The management panel is the core of the mod's interaction.
The left column holds the five sub-modes: press 1 to 5 with the panel open to enter one, and press the same number again or ESC to leave.

Aim at a mage or a building and the target gets a white bounding box; right-click then opens its details page.$(br2)$(bold)The five sub-modes$()$(li)1→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_build_guide)《Build Mode》$(/l): Construct buildings

$(li)2→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_road_guide)《Road Mode》$(/l): Pave roads and shape terrain$(li)3→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_colony_guide)《Town Panel》$(/l): Switch towns and manage members$(li)4→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_tasks_guide)《Task Hall》$(/l): Manage tasks and mage status$(li)5→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_settings_guide)《Settings》$(/l): Modify mod settings
